events.title: Operator starts reversing
events.detail: Repositioning for the next truck at ~3 km/h.

events.title: Banksman walks toward the path
events.detail: Head down, looking for a dropped radio. Not in the operator's mirrors.

events.title: Person entering the rear blind spot
events.detail: Rear radar + camera: banksman 10.0 m behind while reversing.

events.title: Travel speed limited to 1.2 km/h
events.detail: Reverse alarm escalated. Travel governor applied.

events.title: Automatic travel stop
events.detail: Person 6.0 m behind. Travel brakes applied, horn sounded, incident logged.

events.title: Banksman hears the horn and steps clear
events.detail: Moves out of the travel path toward the haul road.

events.title: Without assist: counterweight strikes the banksman
events.detail: Machine still reversing at 3.2 km/h. Operator never saw him.

outcome.assisted: Machine stopped itself. Closest approach 4.6 m from the machine centre, 1.7 m from the counterweight. Near miss logged.
outcome.unassisted: Counterweight strikes the banksman while reversing. Fatal struck-by.
